label: Claude Sonnet 5.5

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hi Sam, Jenna Cole from Brinewatch. Thanks for making time between services.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: No problem, I've got about 15 minutes before lunch prep.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then I'll keep it quick. What made you fill out the form on our site?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We had a bad weekend. The walk-in at our commissary died on a Saturday night, and we didn't find out until Sunday morning.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: What did that cost you?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: About $6,000 in prepped food, and two restaurants ran out of their prep and had to cut half the menu for brunch.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Ouch, how is the commissary set up today?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: One big walk-in cooler, one walk-in freezer, and three trucks that run prep out to the eight restaurants every morning.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: And who keeps an eye on the temperatures right now?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: The kitchen manager checks the walk-ins when she opens and closes. On the weekends, nobody's there overnight.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: So the gap is overnight and weekends, if you had alerts who should get them.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Me and the kitchen manager. I'd rather get a call at midnight than lose another six grand.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Makes sense, have you looked at anything else?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: My chef wants to buy those cheap Bluetooth loggers off the internet. They're like 30 bucks each, but you have to be standing next to them to see anything.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: That's a common starting point. What would make you choose one over the other?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: It has to call or text me when something's wrong, and it can't need a computer person to set up. We don't have one.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Got it and is this your decision or does someone else weigh in?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: It's mine. It's my money.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: What were you thinking of spending?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: I'd like to keep it under 8,000 for the first year, trucks and all.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: That's doable for two walk-ins and three trucks. Here's what I'd suggest. Let's start with the commissary walk-ins this week, since that's where you got burned, and add the trucks once you've seen it work. I'll send you a quote today, and if you sign by Friday, we can install on Monday.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: If you can install Monday, I'll sign Friday.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Deal, I'll send the quote this afternoon.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Sounds good, thanks Jenna.
